items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: He was a great big guy, big as Joe Louis, or bigger -- or Larry Holmes, the heavyweight champion.

ctx.x: Was he a big guy, a small guy or what?

He liked musicians. He was a great big guy, big as Joe Louis, or bigger -- or Larry Holmes, the heavyweight champion. And about just as strong, too, because I seen him pitch guys out of windows and everything. But he never bothered musicians.
Well, the reason that I asked you is because he seems to be a local character around here...
